properties.description:
Copy huge amount of data in bulk from database using external control table to store source table list with partitions for each table.

When you want to migrate data from your Azure Synapse Analytics like Oracle server, Netezza server, Teradata server or SQL Server to Azure, you have to load huge amount of data from multiple tables in data sources. In most cases, data has to be further partitioned in each table so that you can load rows with multiple threads in parallel from single table.

text.value:
USE aer_synapse_db;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. RUN STAMP + SOURCE WINDOW
-- @StartDate/@EndDate come from the pipeline (same watermark
-- window as PL_EIA_IncrementalIngestion), NOT today's date --
-- Bronze is partitioned by start_date=/end_date=, not by a
-- flat run date.
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @StartDate NVARCHAR(10) = '@{pipeline().parameters.StartDate}';
DECLARE @EndDate   NVARCHAR(10) = '@{pipeline().parameters.EndDate}';

DECLARE @RunStamp NVARCHAR(25) =
    REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120), '-', '')
    + '_'
    + REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 108), ':', '');

DECLARE @TableName NVARCHAR(200) = 'dbo.fact_oilprice_' + @RunStamp;
DECLARE @Location  NVARCHAR(400) =
    '/gold/fact_oilprice/' + @StartDate + '_' + @EndDate + '/run_' + @RunStamp + '/';
DECLARE @BronzePath NVARCHAR(400) =
    '/bronze/oilprice/start_date=' + @StartDate + '/end_date=' + @EndDate + '/*.parquet';

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DROP EXISTING EXTERNAL TABLE METADATA IF RE-RUNNING
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @DropSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'IF OBJECT_ID(''' + @TableName + N''') IS NOT NULL DROP EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @TableName + N';';
EXEC sp_executesql @DropSQL;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. CETAS: Bronze EIA Parquet -> Gold OilPrice Parquet
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ' + @TableName + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''' + @Location + N''',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    TRY_CAST([period] AS DATE) AS PriceDate,
    TRY_CAST([value] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS OilPrice_USD,
    [series-description] AS SeriesDescription,
    GETDATE() AS Loaded_At
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK ''' + @BronzePath + N''',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b
WHERE [period] IS NOT NULL
  AND [value] IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST([value] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) IS NOT NULL;';

EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;

scripts.text:
USE aer_synapse_db;

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. RUN DATE VARIABLES
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @RunDate NVARCHAR(10) =
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 120);

DECLARE @RunDateClean NVARCHAR(8) =
    REPLACE(@RunDate, '-', '');


------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DROP EXISTING DAILY EXTERNAL TABLES
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @DropSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
    IF OBJECT_ID(''dbo.quarantine_' + @RunDateClean + N''') IS NOT NULL
        DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.quarantine_' + @RunDateClean + N';

    IF OBJECT_ID(''dbo.silver_clean_' + @RunDateClean + N''') IS NOT NULL
        DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.silver_clean_' + @RunDateClean + N';
';

EXEC sp_executesql @DropSQL;


------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. CREATE QUARANTINE EXTERNAL TABLE
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @QuarantineSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.quarantine_' + @RunDateClean + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''/quarantine/well_rejects/' + @RunDate + N'/'',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT AS WellID,
    WELL_NAME AS WellName,
    LICENSE_NO AS LicenceNumber,
    LICENCE_STATUS AS LicenceStatus,
    LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE AS LicenceIssueDate,
    OPERATOR_CODE AS OperatorCode,
    WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS WellTotalDepth,

    CASE
        WHEN UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NULL
             OR UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT = ''''
            THEN ''NULL_UWI''

        WHEN LEN(LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE) <> 8
            THEN ''INVALID_DATE''

        WHEN TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) < 0
            THEN ''NEGATIVE_DEPTH''

        ELSE ''OTHER''
    END AS RejectReason,

    GETDATE() AS QuarantineDate

FROM OPENROWSET
(
    BULK ''/bronze/well/' + @RunDate + N'/*.parquet'',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b

WHERE UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NULL
   OR UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT = ''''
   OR LEN(LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE) <> 8
   OR TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) < 0;
';

EXEC sp_executesql @QuarantineSQL;


------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. CREATE CLEAN SILVER EXTERNAL TABLE
------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @SilverSQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.silver_clean_' + @RunDateClean + N'
WITH
(
    LOCATION = ''/silver/clean/' + @RunDate + N'/'',
    DATA_SOURCE = aer_adls,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT
    UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT AS WellID,
    KEY_LIST_OF_WELLS AS WellKeyID,

    LTRIM(RTRIM(WELL_NAME)) AS WellName,

    FIELD_CODE AS FieldCode,
    POOL_CODE AS PoolCode,

    LICENSE_NO AS LicenceNumber,
    LICENCE_STATUS AS LicenceStatus,

    TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE, 112) AS LicenceIssueDate,

    LICENSEE_CODE AS LicenseeCode,
    OPERATOR_CODE AS OperatorCode,

    TRY_CONVERT(DATE, FIN_DRL_DATE, 112) AS FinDrlDate,

    TRY_CAST(
        WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)
    ) AS WellTotalDepth,

    WELL_STAT_CODE AS WellStatCode,

    TRY_CONVERT(
        DATE,
        WELL_STAT_DATE,
        112
    ) AS WellStatDate,

    CASE
        WHEN FLUID_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(FLUID_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS FluidDesc,

    CASE
        WHEN MODE_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(MODE_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS ModeDesc,

    CASE
        WHEN TYPE_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(TYPE_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS TypeDesc,

    CASE
        WHEN STRUCTURE_SHORT_DESC = ''N/A''
            THEN NULL
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(STRUCTURE_SHORT_DESC))
    END AS StructureDesc,

    ''BATCH_' + @RunDate + N''' AS BatchID,

    GETDATE() AS IngestionDate,

    ''WellList.txt'' AS SourceFile

FROM OPENROWSET
(
    BULK ''/bronze/well/' + @RunDate + N'/*.parquet'',
    DATA_SOURCE = ''aer_adls'',
    FORMAT = ''PARQUET''
) AS b

WHERE UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT IS NOT NULL
  AND UWI_DISPLAY_FORMAT <> ''''
  AND LEN(LICENSE_ISSUE_DATE) = 8
  AND TRY_CAST(WELL_TOTAL_DEPTH AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) >= 0;
';

EXEC sp_executesql @SilverSQL;

properties.description: Fetches WTI oil prices from EIA REST API since the last successful load (watermark-driven date range), with proper manual offset pagination, capped exponential backoff per page, and late-arriving-data handling (watermark only advances when rows were actually returned). Lands to ADLS Bronze, loads staging.OilPrice from Bronze, then conditionally advances the watermark. Exposes the extraction window as a pipeline return value for downstream Gold processing.

activities.name: Lookup_Watermark
activities.description: Read the last successfully processed source date for the current pipeline from control.PipelineWatermark.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT LastSuccessfulLoadDate FROM control.PipelineWatermark WHERE PipelineName = ''', pipeline().Pipeline, '''')

activities.name: Set_BronzeFolderPath
activities.description: Deterministic Bronze path based on the extraction window so rerunning the same watermark window targets the same logical Bronze location.

activities.name: Set_StartDate
activities.description: Start from the day after LastSuccessfulLoadDate. Falls back to EIA_DefaultLookbackDays if the watermark row is missing (first-ever run, or table was reset) — self-healing rather than crashing.

activities.name: Get_EIAKey
activities.description: Fetch EIA API key from Key Vault. Built-in retry only.

activities.name: Get_EIATotal
activities.description: Cheap probe call (length=1) purely to read response.total for this date range. WebActivity captures the JSON body, which Copy activity cannot.

activities.name: Until_AllPagesFetched
activities.description: Manual offset pagination. Loops until v_PageOffset covers v_ResponseTotal, or retries are exhausted. If v_ResponseTotal is 0 (no data yet for this window — late arrival), the loop exits immediately with success and zero pages copied.

activities.name: Copy_EIAPage_To_Bronze
activities.description: Copies one EIA page to a deterministic page file in the extraction-window Bronze folder; the offset advances only after success.

activities.name: Reset_RetryCount
activities.description: Backoff resets per page — a slow page shouldn't inflate the delay for the next page's first attempt.

activities.name: Wait_CurrentDelay
activities.description: Same page retried after capped exponential wait.

activities.name: Check_PaginationResult
activities.description: If the loop exited because retries were exhausted (not because pagination completed), fail explicitly rather than loading a partial Bronze folder.

typeProperties.message: EIA pagination did not complete after retries exhausted on one page.

activities.name: Copy_Bronze_To_SQL
activities.description: Reads the ENTIRE day's Bronze folder (all page files, recursive, via wildcard) — does NOT call EIA again. Runs even if zero rows exist (writes/truncates an empty result), which is fine since the watermark won't advance in that case.

activities.name: Check_DataAvailability
activities.description: Only advance the watermark if EIA actually returned rows for this window (v_ResponseTotal > 0). If total was 0 — source data not yet published for this date range — the watermark is left untouched, so the next scheduled run retries the exact same window automatically. This is how late-arriving source data is handled: no fixed lookback buffer, no manual backfill required.

ifTrueActivities.name: Update_Watermark
ifTrueActivities.description: Advance watermark ONLY after SQL load succeeds AND rows were actually present. A failed run, or a run with zero rows for a late-arriving date, never advances it.

text.value:
@concat(
'MERGE control.PipelineWatermark AS target
USING (SELECT ''',
pipeline().Pipeline,
''' AS PipelineName) AS src
ON target.PipelineName = src.PipelineName

WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET
    LastSuccessfulLoadDate = ''',
variables('v_EndDate'),
''',
    LastSuccessfulRunTime = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    LastSuccessfulRunId = ''',
pipeline().RunId,
''',
    LastUpdatedTime = SYSUTCDATETIME()

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
    PipelineName,
    LastSuccessfulLoadDate,
    LastSuccessfulRunTime,
    LastSuccessfulRunId,
    LastUpdatedTime
)
VALUES (
    ''',
pipeline().Pipeline,
''',
    ''',
variables('v_EndDate'),
''',
    SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    ''',
pipeline().RunId,
''',
    SYSUTCDATETIME()
);'
)

activities.name: Set_PipelineReturnValue
activities.description: Exposes v_StartDate/v_EndDate as pipeline return value so the master orchestrator can pass the same watermark window to PL_Bronze_OilPrice_to_Gold. Runs regardless of which Check_DataAvailability branch executed, so downstream consumers always know the extraction window — even if it was a late-arriving-data no-op.
